label: saturated near 1; dips in last ~10 trials, deepest after/at a1->S2 rare
explanation: Raw update gate z is saturated at ~0.999 and only dips (to ~0.97) in the final ~10 trials of the episode. Most of the beyond-decile variance (dev 0.42 of 0.50) is finer within-decile timing: a hinge in ep_trial from trial 90, steepening toward trial 99, deeper at GO. Content modulates the size of that late dip: larger after choosing a1 (at D2), largest at D1 after an a1->S2 (rare) trial and at D2 when a1 reached S2, and slightly larger when the policy favours a1 at D1/GO. Early in the episode, content effects are ~1e-4 and negligible. All terms are observed-only (the future-action version scored the same, 0.50 dev). The additive-cue ceiling in the profile is only 0.06 because those cues miss the late-episode interaction; the explanation is mostly a timing refinement, which is why it is partial.
final_label: saturated near 1; dips in last ~10 trials, deepest after/at a1->S2 rare
